text:
Tara N: Hey all 3 I had a weird trip. My paper receipts for two dinners got water-damaged (coffee spill) and the printed VAT receipt from a boutique shop in Milan is smudged. Also used a conference voucher for registration so the airline ticket is split (voucher + small card charge). I paid a taxi in cash for 15 and only have the driver's handwritten note. What should I upload?
Ravi (People Ops): Ugh, sorry. Short answer: upload everything you have, even damaged scans. For the torn/smudged VAT paper, scan what remains and mark as "VAT - damaged" in the notes. Finance will review for legibility.
Tara N: For the damaged dinners 3 amounts are legible but merchant name partly smeared. I took photos right after it happened.
Finance Ops Bot: Photos are fine. Upload the photos as JPEGs and include a short attestation on the form describing why the receipts are damaged. For missing merchant names, add the card transaction screenshot showing the merchant string if available. Manager approval required for any attested receipts.
Marta C: I approve the attestations for Tara's receipts. Marta C (manager).
Tara N: Taxi driver gave a handwritten slip with date and amount but no VAT. Is that acceptable?
Ravi (People Ops): For low-value cash taxis (under 25) a driver note + manager approval is acceptable. Use the taxi attestation template and attach the handwritten note as evidence.
Tara N: About the voucher 3 the conference portal shows registration paid by voucher; my card shows a "+$27 taxes/fees" line. Should I just upload the itinerary?
Finance Ops Bot: Upload the conference invoice showing voucher payment and your card transaction for the taxes/fees. In the expense form choose "Voucher/Award travel/event" and set Payment Type = Personal Card (reimburse) for the taxes. No extra approval unless > $500.
Tara N: The Milan boutique VAT receipt is partially unreadable. If Finance can't process the VAT, will that block my whole reimbursement?
Ravi (People Ops): No, Finance will separate VAT processing from the reimbursable expense. They may accept the net expense and hold the VAT line as "requires follow-up". If VAT recovery fails later, they will adjust. Upload the damaged VAT receipt and add a note "attempting VAT recovery - stamp not legible".
Tara N: Lost boarding pass 3 used mobile e-boarding but saved the PDF. Is that fine for airline refund claim?
Finance Ops Bot: E-ticket PDF + card transaction + any carrier emails are sufficient for refund/claims. Attach bag tag or claim reference if applicable.
Marta C: One tiny ask 3 can you name uploads like we usually do?
Tara N: What's the exact pattern again?
Ravi (People Ops): Use: YYYYMMDD_vendor_purpose_amount_currency and append _attest or _damaged if needed. Examples: 20261201_TrattoriaGallo_dinner_48.50_EUR_damaged.jpg or 20261201_Taxi_attest_15_EUR_attest.pdf. For VAT forms add _VAT.
Tara N: Cool. Anything special for cash ATM fees? I had a 3 ATM fee when withdrawing tips.
Finance Ops Bot: ATM fees tied to business travel are reimbursable. Upload bank screenshot showing the withdrawal and fee, or attest if receipt missing. Tag "expenses-foreign-fees" if outside home currency.
Tara N: Receipts are from last month, within 30 days. Good. I'll assemble and tag @Ravi for a pre-check before I submit. Thanks!
Ravi (People Ops): Happy to review before submission. :thumbsup:
